model_annotation: The chart presents a bar graph illustrating the accuracy scores achieved by various language models across different test sets, including Cardio, Gastro, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, alongside an average score. The horizontal axis represents the test sets, ordered alphabetically from Cardio to Pediatrics. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, displays a linear scale ranging from approximately 35% to 53%, with tick intervals of 5% and numerical values indicated at each tick mark. The bars represent the accuracy scores for each test set, with the Cardio test set having a bar of approximately 51.8%, the Gastro test set having a bar of approximately 54.9%, the Infect test set having a bar of approximately 53.9%, the Neuro test set having a bar of approximately 54.8%, the Obstetrics test set having a bar of approximately 54.4%, and the Pediatrics test set having a bar of approximately 49.1%. The average accuracy score, represented by a bar, is approximately 46.4%.  All bars are presented in a descending order based on accuracy scores, and the bar for the Cardio test set is shaded in blue.
